claims: St. John's University is a private, Catholic, and Vincentian institution.
St. John's University is located in Queens, New York City.
St. John's University was founded in 1870.
St. John's University offers over 100 undergraduate programs.
St. John's University serves roughly 15,640 undergraduate students.
The primary campus of St. John's University is in Queens.
St. John's University had a campus location in Staten Island that closed in 2024.
St. John's University has a campus location in Manhattan.
St. John's University has a campus location in Rome.
St. John's University has a campus location in Paris.
St. John's University has a campus location in Seville.
St. John's University includes the College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences.
St. John's University has an approximate 83% acceptance rate.
Many admitted students to St. John's University hold GPAs between 3.5 and 4.0.
St. John's University athletics are nicknamed the "Red Storm".
The mascot of St. John's University is "Johnny Thunderbird".
St. John's University competes in the NCAA Division I Big East Conference.
The St. John's University men's basketball team reached the Sweet 16 in 2026 under coach Rick Pitino.
